contests.title: Canaan Township — Additional fire and EMS levy

provenance.quote:
An additional tax for the benefit of
Canaan Township for the purpose
of fire and emergency medical
services that the county auditor
estimates will collect $395,115
annually, at a rate not exceeding
2.5 mills for each $1 of taxable
value, which amounts to $88 for
each $100,000 of the county
auditor’s market value, for 3 years,
commencing in 2026, first due in
calendar year 2027.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Adds a property-tax levy for fire and emergency medical services for three years, commencing in 2026 and first due in 2027. The rate is capped at 2.5 mills per dollar of taxable value; the auditor estimates $395,115 in annual collections and $88 per $100,000 of market value.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the additional three-year fire and EMS levy.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not impose this additional levy.
